items.heading: Shortlist Three Serious Directions From
items.text: Shortlist three serious directions from the chart above. Do not compare every option in at once. Pick the three that genuinely interest you, for example, one MSc route, one government or private job route, and one bridge route.

items.heading: Run the Four Questions
items.text: Run the four questions on each shortlisted direction. Check fit, money and time context, real market evidence, and how each path holds up against AI and automation pressure.

items.heading: Complete One Proof Task
items.text: Complete one proof task for your top two options. Write a short literature review, document a lab or field project, or build one small domain-plus-data project, something that tests real interest, not imagined interest.

items.heading: Verify Current Eligibility and Vacancy
items.text: Verify current eligibility and vacancy details on official sources. Confirm MSc entrance cutoffs, NET/JRF eligibility, or the specific government posting's qualification list directly on the official exam or recruiter page before committing time or money.
